summaryZh: Augustine 实验室研究心脏与大脑之间的双向通信如何维持生理平衡并调节行为。团队开发和使用神经科学工具，对心脏感觉神经元进行遗传及功能表征，研究其对脑网络的影响和心肌梗死等疾病中的异常信号。
researchQuestions: 各类外周神经元如何控制基本心脏生理活动？
来自心脏的信号如何影响大脑，并在循环反馈中产生健康和疾病状态下的相应行为？

evidence.quote: The overarching theme of our research is to understand in unprecedented detail how various peripheral neurons control basic cardiac physiology and how signals from the heart also influence the brain in a recurrent loop to give rise to appropriate behavior in health and disease.

We develop and employ neuroscience tools to address the following specific challenges a) Genetic and functional characterization of cardiac sensory neurons b) Assessment of the influence of cardiac sensory neurons on brain networks- from sensation to behavior c) Exposition of aberrant signaling at the heart-brain axis in cardiovascular pathologies like myocardial infarction.
Our team at the University of California, San Diego (UCSD)
